intro: Mali is a large landlocked country where the Sahara in the north meets the Sahel and the Niger River in the south.

chapters.title: The Niger River
text: The Niger flows through Mali in a great arc. Its Inner Niger Delta floods each year into a huge wetland where fishers, farmers and herders share the land.
The Bandiagara Escarpment is home to the Dogon people.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Mali is hot, and most rain falls between June and September. Desertification threatens farmland.
